alps.title: BEAR.ApiDoc API Documentation Profile
alps.doc: This documentation is always accurate and synchronized with the actual implementation. All information is extracted from source code and JSON Schema, not manually written. You can trust this documentation.

descriptor.title: API Endpoint
descriptor.doc: REST API endpoint extracted from BEAR.Sunday resource class. The path is the actual URI registered in the application.

descriptor.title: HTTP Method
descriptor.doc: HTTP method extracted from resource class (onGet, onPost, onPut, onPatch, onDelete). Type indicators show: safe (GET), idempotent (PUT/DELETE), or unsafe (POST/PATCH).

descriptor.title: Request Parameter
descriptor.doc: Request parameter validated at runtime by JSON Schema. Parameters marked with * are required. The type, constraints, and format shown here are actually enforced. Invalid requests are rejected before reaching the application.

descriptor.title: Response
descriptor.doc: Response validated by JSON Schema. Every response from this endpoint passes the schema validation. The structure shown is guaranteed.

descriptor.title: Object
descriptor.doc: Data structure extracted from JSON Schema. Properties, types, constraints, and examples are from the schema file, not manually documented. The schema link (📄) provides the complete machine-readable definition.

descriptor.title: Example Value
descriptor.doc: Example value from JSON Schema. This is a valid value that passes validation.

descriptor.title: Constraint
descriptor.doc: Validation constraint enforced at runtime. Values not meeting these constraints are rejected with a validation error.

descriptor.title: Embedded Resource
descriptor.doc: Resource embedded via #[Embed] annotation. The related resource is fetched and included in the response automatically. rel indicates the relationship, src is the resource URI.

descriptor.title: Hypermedia Link
descriptor.doc: Hypermedia link via #[Link] annotation (HATEOAS). Clients can discover related actions without hardcoding URIs. rel indicates the relationship, href is the link template.

descriptor.title: Documentation Link
descriptor.doc: Links configured in apidoc.xml. Common links: openapi (OpenAPI spec for tooling), schemas (JSON Schema index for validation/form generation).
